# What we override, and what it leans on

Each row is something that would still run but stop working if upstream moved. `python scripts/overrides.py --check` fails when the line in the last column is gone, which is the point of the table.

408 overrides.

## What we would ask upstream

A small change in frappe, erpnext or hrms after which our side of the row could go. Ours stays until theirs lands.

| Row | Upstream | Ask |
|---|---|---|
| The Bank Reconciliation Tool starts on the company's bank account | `erpnext/erpnext/accounts/doctype/bank_reconciliation_tool/bank_reconciliation_tool.js` | The documented frappe.ui.form.on onload and refresh handlers are already minimal. Propose two things to erpnext's bank_reconciliation_tool.js: show the 'new Banking module' intro only when the banking app is installed (frappe.boot.versions.banking), and default bank_account to the company's default company Bank Account. Then bank.js can go. |
| A payment is titled by the party's name | `erpnext/erpnext/accounts/doctype/payment_entry/payment_entry.py` | Payment Entry validate swaps title from party ID to party_name after set_title. Propose upstream PaymentEntry.set_title use `self.party_name or self.party` (payment_entry.py:1249); then paid.titled and its patch can go. |
| A finished asset depreciates from the end of the month it was bought | `erpnext/erpnext/assets/doctype/asset/asset.py` | finish() blanks depreciation_start_date after set_missing_values so Asset.validate's get_last_day(available_for_use_date) default (asset.py:627) applies. Propose get_item_details' finance book rows use d.depreciation_start_date without `or nowdate()` (asset.py:1131); then the blanking goes. |
| A maintenance task with an end date is due | `erpnext/erpnext/assets/doctype/asset_maintenance/asset_maintenance.py` | maintenance.next_due re-implements calculate_next_due_date because upstream blanks the date whenever an end date is set (`or next_due_date`, asset_maintenance.py:128). Propose changing that clause to `or (next_due_date and getdate(next_due_date) > getdate(end_date))` and computing next_due_date in AssetMaintenance.validate; then `due` can call upstream's function. |
| A service moved past today is no longer late | `erpnext/erpnext/assets/doctype/asset_maintenance_log/asset_maintenance_log.py` | before_validate puts Overdue back to Planned when due_date is not past. Propose AssetMaintenanceLog.validate do the reverse itself (Overdue -> Planned when due_date >= today), a two-line change at asset_maintenance_log.py:45. |
| A quote priced on the portal keeps the request's project | `erpnext/erpnext/buying/doctype/request_for_quotation/mapper.py` | _quote reuses mapper.add_items then copies each RFQ row's project_name onto the quote row. Propose adding "project": rfq_row.get("project_name") to the args in mapper.create_rfq_items (request_for_quotation/mapper.py:140), then drop our loop. |
| An appointment's meeting is on its maker's calendar | `erpnext/erpnext/crm/doctype/appointment/appointment.py` | Appointment validate/on_update set and clear a flag that events.validate reads while Appointment.after_insert/on_update insert the Event; it works only because create_calendar_event runs inside that save. Propose upstream that create_calendar_event take the event type from Appointment Booking Settings (or default to Private), and drop booking/booked then. |
| A lead's status is the colour of what it means | `erpnext/erpnext/crm/doctype/lead/lead_list.js` | Same as row 1: propose `states` on erpnext's lead.json, since frappe.get_indicator reads meta.states ahead of get_indicator. Keep our COLOUR override (extends settings, copies nothing) until then. |
| An opportunity's status is the colour of what it means | `erpnext/erpnext/crm/doctype/opportunity/opportunity_list.js` | Ours extends listview_settings and only swaps get_indicator for a self-contained colour map, so nothing of theirs is copied. Propose `states` (DocType State: Open blue, Replied orange, Quotation purple, Converted green, Lost/Closed gray) in erpnext's opportunity.json: frappe.get_indicator checks meta.states before listview get_indicator, so the colours become schema and our COLOUR map can go. Our app cannot ship this declaratively itself, because sync_customizations does not sync DocType State. |
| Workshop time has an account before anything is made | `erpnext/erpnext/manufacturing/doctype/bom/services/operations_cost.py` | The Inventory Check sets Company.default_operating_cost_account through the Company's own save. Propose adding "default_operating_cost_account": "Expenses Included In Valuation" to the default_accounts map in Company.set_default_accounts (company.py ~line 750), which would make the Fix unnecessary on new companies. |
| A work order takes its bill's steps however it is saved | `erpnext/erpnext/manufacturing/doctype/work_order/work_order.py` | before_validate calls WorkOrder.set_work_order_operations, upstream's own public method, only when operations are empty. Propose upstream WorkOrder.validate do the same (fill operations from a with_operations BOM when the table is empty), so Data Import and API work orders get job cards. |
| A task made from a template keeps its milestone, time and checklist | `erpnext/erpnext/projects/doctype/project/project.py` | Task before_insert copies is_milestone, expected_time and checklist from template_task. Propose adding is_milestone=task_details.is_milestone and expected_time=task_details.expected_time to Project.create_task_from_template (project.py:139-155); keep ours for one_steps. |
| The Task tree leaves templates out and names a task once | `erpnext/erpnext/projects/doctype/task/task_tree.js` | task_tree.js only extends treeview_settings, but one_task.views.children re-implements erpnext's task.get_children to add NOT_A_TEMPLATE and status. Propose that erpnext's get_children filter out is_template tasks and return status. Then ours keeps only get_label. |
| The timesheet timer is ours | `erpnext/erpnext/projects/doctype/timesheet/timesheet.js` | Ours removes their Start/Resume Timer by label and draws its own timer, so a renamed label would show both. Propose that erpnext's timesheet.js resume only a row with from_time and no to_time, and that Complete not overwrite an existing to_time. Keep ours until then. |

Propose upstream set_user fall back to owner only when there is no employee (timesheet.py:153-156); then remove the Timesheet entry from override_doctype_class. |
| A document in the company's currency says its taxes once | `erpnext/erpnext/public/js/controllers/transaction.js` | Propose that erpnext's change_form_labels skip the base_ tax fields in its taxes_fields loop when doc.currency == company_currency. That loop re-shows the fields the earlier toggle hid, which is a one-condition bug fix. Then the second wrapper in rate_note.js goes. |
| The exchange rate is said with the rate in it | `erpnext/erpnext/public/js/controllers/transaction.js` | Wraps three erpnext.TransactionController prototype methods. A subclass that overrides change_form_labels would bypass it. Propose that erpnext's transaction.js write the actual rate in the conversion_rate and plc_conversion_rate description (and refresh it on change) instead of '[?]'. Then the first half of rate_note.js goes. |
| The timer stamps one clock | `erpnext/erpnext/public/js/projects/timer.js` | Propose that erpnext's public/js/projects/timer.js stamp with frappe.datetime.now_datetime() (site tz) instead of get_datetime_as_string() (browser tz), matching what it measures against. Together with row 143 this would let timesheet.js's timer go. |
| A new lead or deal with one series does not show it | `erpnext/erpnext/public/js/utils.js` | Propose that erpnext.toggle_naming_series in public/js/utils.js stay hidden when the field has a single option or is hidden by a property setter. Then crm_record.one_series and its two callers can go. |
| A lead's and a deal's comment box is shown again | `erpnext/erpnext/public/js/utils/crm_activities.js` | `display:block !important` beats an inline style from erpnext's crm_activities.js, whose `$(".comment-box").hide()` is unscoped and hides every comment box in the DOM. Propose dropping that line, or scoping it to this.form_wrapper. Then our rule goes. |
| An item with stock keeps Batches and Serial Numbers locked | `erpnext/erpnext/stock/doctype/item/item.js` | Ours adds a second toggle_has_serial_batch_fields handler that re-locks the fields. Propose that erpnext's item.js call `frm.toggle_enable([...], !hide_fields && !frm.doc.__onload?.stock_exists)`, a one-line fix since the server already refuses the change. Then item_form.js can go. |
| A line's size sets its quantity | `erpnext/erpnext/stock/get_item_details.py` | measure.unit copies get_item_details' default-unit rule and has drifted: ERPNext gives the stock unit to Request for Quotation lines and to non-Purchase Material Requests (get_item_details.py:596-603), ours gives the purchase unit. Propose upstream factor that rule into a public helper (doctype, item, material_request_type) and call it here; fix the drift meanwhile. |
| A quote request on the portal is the app's page, and sending a quote works | `erpnext/erpnext/templates/pages/rfq.html` | send_quote reproduces mapper.create_supplier_quotation (get_quotable_rfq, validate_existing_supplier_quotation, add_items, set_missing_values) with frappe.session.user switched to Administrator, and sets form_dict to call templates.pages.rfq.get_supplier. Propose upstream that create_supplier_quotation run set_missing_values with item reads permission-free for a verified portal user, so ours can call it and only add discounts. |
| Marks become sprite symbols | `frappe/frappe/core/doctype/custom_icon/custom_icon.py` | scripts/icons.py writes a Custom Icon fixture with ids prefixed per mark because CustomIcon.to_symbol keeps ids as-is and one sprite shares them. Propose to_symbol prefix every id and url(#id) with icon_name; then unique_ids in our script drops. |
| A rolled-back naming rule leaves the cache too | `frappe/frappe/core/doctype/document_naming_rule/document_naming_rule.py` | naming._write registers frappe.db.after_rollback.add(_forget) to clear the Document Naming Rule doctype map. Propose DocumentNamingRule.clear_doctype_map also register itself on after_rollback (same for any doctype-map cache); ours drops then. |
| A stored file is decoded the way Frappe decodes one | `frappe/frappe/core/doctype/file/file.py` | one_storage.file.decoded copies the 8-line decode loop of File.get_content (filetype.guess, OLE_FILE_SIGNATURE, FILE_ENCODING_OPTIONS). Propose frappe factor it into a module function (e.g. decode_file_bytes(content, encodings)) that get_content calls; ours then imports it. |
